(Part 1) |java=[[Masaki Terasoma]] }} '''J's client''' is a character who appeared in ''[[DP071|Pokémon Ranger and the Kidnapped Riolu! Part 1]]'' and ''[[DP072|Part 2]]''. He commissioned [[J]] to capture the [[Aura Sphere Riolu]]. ==History== [[File:J client henchmen.png|thumb|left|220px|J's client's henchmen]] J's client first appeared in ''[[DP071|Pokémon Ranger and the Kidnapped Riolu! (Part 1)]]'', where he was met with his henchmen after they successfully stole the [[Aura Sphere Riolu]] from a laboratory facility. After Riolu escaped from his clutches, he contacted [[J|Hunter J]] to capture Riolu on his behalf. In ''[[DP072|Pokémon Ranger and the Kidnapped Riolu! (Part 2)]]'', he was pleased to learn that Riolu was captured and met J to collect it. However, {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}}, [[Officer Jenny]], and {{OBP|Pokémon Ranger|Ranger series}}s [[Kellyn]] and [[Solana]] intervened. Hunter J quickly left in her airship, leaving her client and his crew to handle them. While his henchmen helped stall the pursuit, Ash and Kellyn caught up to him by a cave. J's client prevented the pair from gaining on him by having his {{p|Aggron}} block the entrance with {{m|Rock Smash}}. Kellyn was able to destroy the cave-ins with a {{p|Donphan}} nearby. With the help of Ash's [[Aura]], the two were able to locate J's client. J's client battled Ash and Kellyn with Aggron and was defeated by {{AP|Pikachu}}'s {{m|Volt Tackle}}, causing Aggron to land onto him. J's client and his henchmen were later arrested by Officer Jenny and the Aura Sphere Riolu was returned to its home in [[Lucario Kingdom]]. ==Character== Hunter J's client is motivated by power, hence his interest in the rare [[Aura Sphere Riolu]]. He is quick-thinking and determined, using his Pokémon to ensure he got his way. However, he and his henchmen were taken aback by the {{OBP|Pokémon Ranger|Ranger series}}s' surprise tactics and quickly outnumbered. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} This listing is of J's client's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=J's client |pkmn=Fearow |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=J client Fearow.png |epnum=DP072 |epname=Pokémon Ranger and the Kidnapped Riolu!
